text:
tess: Quick sync after the postmortem. We're seeing a weekly recurrence of partial-streams tied to reconnect storms during region failovers. Need an actionable plan with owners + short deadlines.

omar: Agreed. My read: two orthogonal problems: (A) client reconnect cadence amplifies transient load, (B) server-side circuit closes streams too eagerly. Recommend split work.

frank: I'll take (A) client cadence. Plan: implement a client-side jittered backoff + soft-hedging (start a secondary resume attempt at 2x RTT).

nina: I'll take (B) server circuit breaker and graceful-degrade mode. Proposed behavior: when node CPU > 85% or handshake_rtt p95 > 1s, mark node AS_DEGRADED and keep streams open but mark them 'degraded' to clients.

drew: Observability: add a composite metric stream.reconnect_spike and an event that captures reconnect origin (client vs infra). Add an annotation for failover windows.

sre-bot: [monitor] 2300012370: alert stream.partial_rate p95=0.9% (>0.5%) in us-west-2.

tess: Action list (short):
- T1 frank: SDK reconnect + hedging prototype // due 2026-04-02
- T2 nina: circuit-breaker + degraded-state flag // due 2026-04-01
- T3 drew: dashboards + reconnect_spike metric + runbook // due 2026-03-30
- T4 omar: infra rollout plan + canary config for graceful-degrade // due 2026-03-31

frank: SDK pseudo:
```// hedging prototype
if (request.latency > rtt_threshold) {
  schedule(resume, delay = base * (1 + rand()))
  if (hedge_enabled) start_hedge_try(after = rtt * 2)
}
```

omar: For infra rollout we should try a single AZ canary where degraded-state only adds metadata and doesn't change routing. Then enable circuit-breaker behavior in next step.

nina: Circuit-breaker knobs: consecutive_handshake_failures, p95_handshake_latency_ms, active_streams_pct. We should log 'degrade_reason' on stream frames.

drew: Runbook steps for oncall: 1) check reconnect_spike dashboard, 2) identify recent node restarts, 3) if degraded-state present, toggle routing fallback and engage infra canary.

tess: Also want a short-term client mitigation: if resume_token is present, prefer resume-over-full-reopen for N attempts. frank can add config flag resume_prefer_count.

frank: yep, will add resume_prefer_count and default to 3. Also adding telemetry to track resume_success_rate.

omar: Performance concern: hedging increases load briefly. We'll gate on sampled traffic (1%) and measure net partial reduction before wider rollout.

nina: I'll add an opt-in header for clients to accept degraded streams so we can run a small cohort. header: Accept-Degraded: true

drew: Will create dashboard tiles: reconnect_rate, partial_rate_by_node, resume_success_rate, degraded_streams_count.

sre-bot: [deploy-bot] 2300012390: canary deploy for degraded-state flags to cluster-canary-3 scheduled.

tess: Weekly check: owners update status by Friday. We'll measure both partial_rate and customer-visible latency. If partials drop <0.3% p95 in two windows, consider feature promoted.

frank: Starting branch now. tagging PR with incident-reduce-partials.

omar: I'll draft rollout doc and rollback steps; will include CPU & handshake thresholds.

tess: Thanks all. If blockers surface, post here or DM me. :ear_of_rice:
